thread:
Alex G: quick check — we're trending proto-first for the internal control plane, but client teams keep asking for a simple REST/JSON path for the web SDK. can we land on one pattern without blocking rollouts?

maria: +1 on proto-first for internal services (better type-safety, smaller payloads). but web SDK call latency/server cost matters.

kevin: web SDK can talk to a lightweight gateway that transcodes to proto. keeps internal surface proto while giving web a friendly JSON API.

nina: that works but we've seen two issues: 1) quota accounting can double-count if gateway isn't emitting the right telemetry, 2) subtle contract drift when we auto-transcode.

liz: re telemetry — gateway must add route metadata so console dashboards show the actual backend model & config. otherwise ops can't attribute cost.

Alex G: how about a compatibility contract: gateway must set headers -> `X-Redwood-Backend: model:chat-v2;variant:fp16` and tags for rollout `X-Redwood-Canary=true` so dashboards/rollouts pick it up?

maria: that header idea is fine. also include schema version `X-Proto-Schema: 42` so we can detect transcode mismatches in logs.

kevin: + implement a small lint in gateway CI: validate that every exposed REST route maps to a proto RPC and emits the headers. quick snippet: ```yaml
# gateway lint rule (pseudo)
routes:
  - path: /v1/chat
    maps_to: ChatService.Stream
    emit_headers: [X-Redwood-Backend, X-Proto-Schema, X-Redwood-Canary]
```

nina: quota question: do we charge at gateway (JSON tokenization) or at backend (proto tokens)? We need a single source of truth.

liz: backend should be source of truth for billing. gateway can estimate for preview but must pass token counts in `X-Token-Estimate` and backend returns authoritative `X-Token-Count`. dashboards show backend counts.

Alex G: rollout UX: suggest canary at gateway + backend: gateway can route 5% to new proto schema while emitting canary header. console will show side-by-side latency/cost. if backend rejects, gateway falls back to stable model.

maria: fallback semantics need to be explicit. `Accept` header negotiation can't be silent. if proto-only backend is hit by JSON client, return `406` with a friendly migration payload. or gateway should do a safe transcode if flagged.

kevin: agreed. plan: implement header contract + lint + telemetry fields in gateway by EOW. I'll file a tiny RFC and a checklist for SDK owners to opt into the JSON surface.

liz: I'll add dashboard panels: per-route backend mapping, canary rate, token counts (estimate vs authoritative), and a transcode error rate.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: gateway-lint v0.1 -> staging at 2024-11-05T03:00Z. :rocket:

Alex G: cool. action items: kevin RFC + PR for lint, nina will own fallback UX proposal, liz will add dashboard tiles. we'll reconvene next Tue. :thumbsup:
